message.content:
Sure! To give you a useful estimate, could you let me know a bit more about the project?

- How many coats of paint are you planning to apply (e.g., primer + two topcoats)?
- What type of paint are you using (e.g., standard exterior paint, high‑temperature paint, etc.)?
- How many workers will be involved and what equipment will they have (e.g., scaffolding, lifts, spray guns)?
- Will the work be done in stages (e.g., first the lower half, then the upper half) or all at once?

With those details I can provide a more accurate time frame.

We can ask for clarification or give a general estimate. The user might want a rough estimate.
